title: Reopen a paid invoice
body:
Finance sometimes marks an invoice paid by mistake and needs to undo it.

Add `reopen_invoice(invoice_id)` to `parcelo/invoices.py`. It sets a paid invoice back to "open", clears its `paid_at`, and records when it was reopened in a new `reopened_at` field on the invoice (add the field to the `Invoice` model in `parcelo/models.py`). It returns the invoice.

Reopening an invoice that does not exist must fail. So must reopening one that is not paid.
